channel.title: Kestrel Ridge Health resources
channel.description: Practical ophthalmic technician staffing guides from KRH.

item.title: Before refilling an ophthalmology cancellation, check technician coverage
item.description: An ophthalmology waitlist checklist for checking technician time, imaging and room coverage before booking a replacement visit.

item.title: Ophthalmic technician training: plan the coverage first
item.description: A practical checklist for protecting learner and trainer time, checking supervision and keeping eye clinic sessions covered during technician training.

item.title: How to review an ophthalmology staffing forecast that misses
item.description: Check forecast error, session data and coverage decisions with a practical review process for independent ophthalmology practices.

item.title: Adding an ophthalmologist? Check technician coverage first
item.description: Compare launch options, shared testing resources and cross-site coverage before opening a new physician’s appointment template.

item.title: When screening schedules change, recheck technician coverage
item.description: A practical review for independent eye clinics changing a care pathway, prompted by the AAO’s November 4 journal update on screening timing.

item.title: Before you buy a staffing forecast, check your session data
item.description: A practical readiness checklist and blank worksheet for independent ophthalmology practices evaluating technician workload forecasting.

item.title: Call-Off Coverage for Eye Clinics
item.description: When an ophthalmic technician calls out, eye clinics face a narrow decision window. Options, tradeoffs, and how forecasting changes the math.

item.title: Same-Day Ophthalmology Staffing
item.description: When a technician calls out same-day, most eye clinics have no systematic response. Here is how forecasting-based staffing changes that equation.

item.title: Forecasting Technician Workload by Session
item.description: How session-level workload forecasting differs from ratio staffing, what data it needs, what the ophthalmology literature supports, and where it still fails.

item.title: Ophthalmic Technician Staffing Ratios
item.description: The real vintage and meaning of the ophthalmic staffing benchmarks, which budget decisions they can settle, and which session-level questions they cannot.

item.title: The Tech Shortage You Cannot Hire Your Way Out Of
item.description: Every published fix for the ophthalmic technician shortage is supply-side. The demand-side lever is session variance and allocation across sites. Here is how.
